messages:
hema: packaging reports a cosign TTL error on private-installer:v2026.04.02-rc1. Not fatal yet but we should decide before the 02:00 UTC cutover.

sam: options: 1) re-sign and delay cutover 15m, 2) proceed and register a post-release advisory, 3) manual canary override (risky). Thoughts?

jihoon: technical: one signer had a clock set 9m ahead; verification fails on strict validators. Re-sign via KMS takes ~4m, mirror propagation ~5m.

tanya: deploy-bot has canary at 02:05. If we reissue, it will auto-cancel. We can schedule a paused canary to resume once artifacts verified.

hema: prefer re-sign + short delay. we keep canary and rollback intact.

sam: agreed. set rollback target to v2026.03.15-hotfix. thresholds: error rate > 2.5% for 180s OR p95 latency increase > 40%. Also add a 10m manual hold before auto-rollback to allow final sign fix.

deploy-bot: [deploy] request queued: private/vpc-installer v2026.04.02-rc1 by @hema. Canary group=staging-airgap-5. Window scheduled=02:05-02:35 UTC. Auto-rollback on configured triggers.

jihoon: starting re-sign now. tagging @tanya for mirror verify.

(5m later)

jihoon: re-sign complete. cosign verify PASS. pushing to mirrors.

tanya: mirror-ocean and mirror-mountain show new blob. running quick checksum: sha256=fa12... md5=3b4c...

hema: OK flipping canary to start at 02:15 to give an extra buffer. deploy-bot please update.

deploy-bot: [deploy] canary start updated to 02:15 UTC, window 02:15-02:30 UTC (15m). Monitoring hooks attached.

sam: updating release-notes: "Start delayed 10m due to signer reissue; canary executed and passed; no rollback." Also pushing pin to `private-pinning/rc1/pins.json`.

marta: add a runbook blurb: detect clock skew during signing CI and auto-fail builds older than 5m drift.

jihoon: logged an action item in packaging board.

hema: thanks all. will close once release-notes PR merges and deploy-bot reports final success. :white_check_mark:
